reason: A DeepSeek Harness extension for SillyTavern-style roleplay that imports character cards and lorebooks, creates roleplay workspaces and sessions, and manages prompts, world information, variables, and compatible scripts; its embedded script runner has broad page, session, and network capabilities.

summaries.zh: 导入 SillyTavern 角色卡和世界书，创建角色扮演工作区与会话，并管理提示词、上下文、变量及兼容脚本。
summaries.en: Imports SillyTavern character cards and lorebooks, creates roleplay workspaces and sessions, and manages prompts, context, variables, and compatible scripts.

capabilities: Imports and parses PNG, JSON, and Lorebook character-card files
Creates and manages roleplay workspaces and sessions
Reads, writes, and deletes local character, preset, settings, and state files
Injects prompts, world-book entries, variables, and conversation context
Runs character-card scripts in a hidden iframe with access to session data, page DOM, and external network resources
Exposes plugin API routes and user-interface panels
